Your surface: CONTENT GROUNDING. Review all 10 chapter pages (src/pages/Chapter01.tsx through Chapter10.tsx), the Worksheet (src/pages/Worksheet.tsx), and the Home page (src/pages/Home.tsx) for factual accuracy against the master markdown at /Users/hermes/Projects/echo-springs/echo-springs-runbook.agent.final.md.

Evidence must cite file:line and quote only the needed words. If there are no findings, write 'No findings for this surface.' under Findings and still fill Clean by dimension. Hard rules: no invented facts, mark assumptions, never modify files outside the task directory, and keep the report under 1200 words.

- Accessibility: are there aria labels, keyboard navigation, color contrast issues?
- Design consistency: do all pages follow the design system (check design.md if present, otherwise check for consistent use of Tailwind classes, spacing, typography)?
- Worksheet UX: is the Camp State Worksheet intuitive? Are all fields clearly labeled?
- Visit Log UX: is the log easy to use? Can visits be added, viewed, and exported?
- Password gate UX: is the gate clear and does it provide feedback on wrong passwords?
- Loading/empty states: are there appropriate loading states and empty-state messages?
